Advanced Grain Monitoring Technology for Grain Bins

CentaurOne combines wireless monitoring of grain temperature, moisture, and CO₂ with our Chiron AI grain advisor to help farmers manage stored grain conditions. Its CFD Digital Twin technology provides a broader, predictive picture of conditions throughout the grain bin, while remote and automated fan control helps manage aeration efficiently.

YOUR BIN DOESN’T HAVE TO BE EMPTY.

Unlike traditional temperature cable systems, CentaurOne uses a compact wireless Arrow sensor mounted on the outside of the bin that can be installed even when your grain bin is full. Designed for farm bins up to 50,000 bushels, with custom configurations available for larger storage facilities, the system offers simple DIY installation, minimal maintenance, and affordable grain monitoring technology.

REAL EQUIPMENT. PRACTICAL INSTALLATION.

One Arrow sensor. No cables inside the bin.

The wireless Arrow sensor mounts on the outside of your grain bin and can be installed even when the bin is full.

Combined with CFD Digital Twin technology and Chiron AI, CentaurOne helps you understand grain conditions and make informed aeration decisions.

THE TECHNOLOGY BEHIND THE SENSOR

One Sensor. Thousands of Virtual Measurement Points.

CentaurOne combines real-time Arrow sensor readings with CFD Digital Twin technology to create a detailed picture of temperature, moisture, and CO₂ conditions throughout your grain bin.

Our built-in AI Grain Condition Advisor, Chiron, analyzes this information and explains your grain conditions in clear, practical language without unnecessary technical jargon.

You can even ask Chiron questions about your grain to help you make better grain management and aeration decisions.
